subject: contract §7 (visual language, BINDING) against dsh-Go 1.0.9 docs + the wave's state on feature/mpd-dshgo-native-parity

verdict.appliesTo: contract §7.2 rule 6, §6.1/§7.3 checker gate wording, and the D1 kit's adaptView/avatar/divider surface
verdict.oneSentence: The accent guarantee is structurally sound and the platform vocabulary is legal, but rule 6 cannot be built as written, the only §7 checker passes deliberately non-conforming views, and the single fallback rule that carries the hero's meaning currently loses it.

panels 1, strip 0, actions 0, message 0; the one static view ok
kit-built §7 panel: only the accent dark-mode contrast note

gates.note: exit 0 proves the checker is not a §7 gate
4 arms: legal v2 accepted, planted violations reported, legal v1 accepted, v1 leftovers refused
no v2 component, style or accent survives

1_accent_and_no_named_colour.evidence: no v2 panel root exists yet. The kit writes `accent: "app"` in exactly one place (panelView's root node) and `style()` accepts only `color: "accent"`; no named colour and no #RRGGBB string literal exists in dshgo-view.ts (grep). A built fixture's root is accent=app and the checker's only accent output is the dark-mode contrast note.

2_section_7_2_structure.evidence: probe-section7.mjs implements 11 structural rules (hero count per tab, card variants, metrics-in-grid, one primary, spacing tokens, maxLines, badge word, tone word, empty tab, nested accent, root v2) with a self-test and a negative control; a kit-built conforming fixture passes, the planted-violation fixture fails.

3_v1_adaptView_legibility.evidence: styles/accent stripped and v=1 are correct, tabs/badge/emptyState/inputs become text, divider/spacer drop, actions survive. But grid->list emits [{title:"Ready"},{title:"Active"}] and [{title:"Parked"}]: the metric values 3, 1 and 0 are gone.

4_checker_exit_and_diagnostics.evidence: repo root exit 1 for two package diagnostics unrelated to views (patch-array false positive must be accepted with a reason; engines.dsh warn is closable); static view exit 0; legal v2 exit 0 with the accent dark-mode note and one 'style reserved, ignored' note per primary; deliberately non-conforming tree also exit 0, so exit 0 is not a §7 signal. No colour correction was emitted by the kit: style() refuses every non-accent colour.

findings.title: No v2 panel exists to review
findings.why: §7 governs the v2 panel trees; panels:[mpd] is still the only contribution, mpd-team.json is absent, strip/actions/message are empty, and T2 is pending. A §7 verdict now would certify a fixture, not the product.
findings.direction: Hold T7's §7 half until T2 lands; re-run probe-section7.mjs + check.mjs on the built panels and their adaptView fallbacks.

findings.title: §6.1/§7.3 'checker exit 0' is unachievable and 'fixing' it breaks the bundle
findings.why: The checker requires dsh.bundle.patch to be a STRING; this bundle declares the two-layer ARRAY the harness and the installer depend on. Observed exit 1 with a clean manifest and a clean view. Making the checker green would drop the preset layer.
findings.direction: Amend §6.1/§7.3 to name the evidence: each static view checked alone (exit 0), --json with manifest.state ok and zero manifest issues plus the two package diagnostics accepted with reasons, and built live trees piped to check.mjs - (stdin). Optionally add engines.dsh to clear the warn; do not change dsh.bundle.patch.

findings.title: §7.2 rule 6 'avatar (initials)' cannot be built
findings.why: avatar takes src + alt only, is a 48 dp square with an icon fallback and explicitly no caption. Measured: an avatar with text:'AB' passes the checker with only a source note, silently ignores text and renders the fallback icon, so member initials disappear without a usable diagnostic. An asset avatar would need image bytes and a manifest assets entry the contract never budgets.
findings.direction: Amend rule 6 to badge/text initials (theme token, no asset, trivial v1 fallback), or declare avatar icon-only and budget the asset.

findings.title: adaptView's grid->list fallback drops every metric value
findings.why: Measured on a kit-built, checker-clean panel: grid[metric Ready 3, metric Active 1] becomes list[{title:'Ready'},{title:'Active'}]; the second hero's metric Parked 0 becomes list[{title:'Parked'}]. Rule 10 requires meaning to survive without styles; the numbers are the hero's whole point (rules 2/4).
findings.direction: In the grid fallback map a metric child to {title: label, trailing: String(value)} (list rows support trailing) or to subtitle; keep wordsOf for other children. D1 fix.

findings.title: DshGoAvatarProps promises caption and aspect, which avatar does not execute
findings.why: caption/aspect belong to image; avatar is a fixed 48 dp square with no caption. Unknown node props are silently tolerated (schema node has no additionalProperties:false), so the kit's type leads the panel author into props the app ignores.
findings.direction: Drop them from the type or mark them ignored.

findings.title: divider({size}) accepts a prop the app's divider does not take
findings.why: inputs.md gives divider no props; the checker is silent, so an author would expect a sized rule and get the default.
findings.direction: Remove the prop (spacer.size stays; note its 8/16/24 scale).

findings.title: Rule 1 (no named colour) is not enforced by the app checker
findings.why: A named colour exits 0. The kit makes it unrepresentable, but the guarantee is only as strong as the kit being the sole author; a hand-written node could bypass it.
findings.direction: Assert accent==='app' at the root and no colour but 'accent' on built trees (probe rules ACCENT/COLOUR, or their equivalent in verify-dshgo-views.ts).

findings.title: The checker cannot see the LIVE panel trees in the invocation §6.1 names
findings.why: checkPlugin validates the declared STATIC view files; live v2 functions are reached only by --load, which imports the bundle entry (not a single plugin) and expects a raw ctx.dshGo registration rather than the adapter seam.
findings.direction: Require each lane test to build its tree and pipe it to check.mjs - (stdin), for the v2 tree and for its adaptView fallback; use that as §7.3 evidence.

findings.title: §7.3's 'read the diagnostics' needs an exit code of its own
findings.why: numeric padding, a named colour and two primaries all exit 0, so exit 0 means 'legal and inside budget', never '§7-compliant'.
findings.direction: Make the §7 assertions a gate (probe or verify-dshgo-views.ts), not a reading.

findings.title: spacer S/M/L is 8/16/24 dp while padding/gap S/M/L is 8/12/16
findings.why: same letters, different rhythm; a designer can land on the wrong spacing
findings.direction: one sentence in the kit's spacer doc

findings.title: The tabs fallback repeats the tab label before the hero's own title
findings.why: the v1 tree says 'Board' twice before the first number
findings.direction: skip the label text when the section's first text already carries it

findings.title: accent:'app' always yields a dark-mode contrast note
findings.why: #4B67B4 is corrected to ~#7B8FC8/#899BCE once per distinct background; expected and harmless
findings.direction: report as accepted; never 'fix' by hard-coding a colour

findings.title: style:'primary' yields one 'reserved, ignored' note per action; plugViewOnePrimary never fires
findings.why: rule 8's diagnostic is per-action, not per-view; the app ignores every plugin action style
findings.direction: keep the rule as intent; do not rely on that diagnostic to police it

findings.title: adaptView copies node.title onto replacements at non-root positions
findings.why: the emptyState->text replacement carries title, which the app reads on the root only
findings.direction: copy title only when the replacement is the root
